tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for service businesses (plugin version 4.0.3). The listing documents automatic email notifications: customers get instant booking confirmations; staff get notified; templates can include booking information and custom fields; customers can confirm or cancel via a link in the email. WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. A follow-up consult after a free dinner is a booking you create; a service name such as annuity review or retirement consult is a label you configure. Neither is a documented default. Age, retirement, home-ownership, or IRA-size questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, or input); they are not documented defaults. A booked consult is not a purchase and is not a financial recommendation. Cancelling or missing the consult later does not erase the contact answers already stored next to a name, and does not unsend a confirmation email already delivered. How long that row sits after the dinner ends is not a documented default of the plugin. An optional GDPR setting can auto-remove customer data older than six months; that is not a default purge. Google Calendar, SMS, and payments are Pro. Google reCAPTCHA is optional.
